sketches.mechanism: An interface with no methods (marker interface) — the object is marked but given nothing to do
sketches.resonance: To be named something is not the same as being given purpose; the type system lets you label without substance.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN where the right table has no matching rows, producing NULLs — the query reaches for something that isn't there
sketches.resonance: You can ask to join with someone and still end up with nothing beside you; the NULL columns are the shape of absence.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type — a function that promises to never give anything back, yet is called anyway
sketches.resonance: Some things we reach for are typed as never returning; the compiler knows, and we call them still.
